text.description_html:
Acorn IHMBP, Bean Tip Iron Art Strap Hinge For Heavy Doors

Heavy Duty Bean Tip Hinges are ideal for garages, barns and gates. They not only add an authentic finishing touch but are truly functional as well. Featuring a bean tip, the 36 Inch Heavy Door Bean Tip Strap Hinge is hand forged using traditional hammer and anvil techniques. Zinc and acrylic powder coated, it has a lifetime no-rust warranty. This strap hinge is rated at 600 pounds per pair and have been tested to 1,000 pounds without failure. It is supplied with 1/4 inch by 3 inch stainless steel square head lags.

Also Available Matching: 30 Inch Heavy Door Bean Tip Strap Hinge

Specifications of the 36" Bean Tip Strap Hinge For Heavy Doors:

  • Zinc and acrylic powder coated for long lasting life.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws and a 1/4 x 3" stainless steel square head lag.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 36" Bean Tip Iron Art Hinge:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Rated at 600 pounds per pair.
  • Length: 36"
  • Strap Width at Hinge: 3"
  • Length of Pad: 6"
  • Width of Pad: 3-3/4"

Sold Individually
